label: 2. Tests for a Mean — z and t

link.title: 2. Tests for a Mean — z and t
link.description: The workhorse tools for a single average. The z-test when the population standard deviation is known and the sample is large; the Student-t distribution and the t-test for the far more common case where σ is unknown and estimated from the sample; a decision rule for choosing between them; and the estimation face of the same machinery — the confidence interval and its margin of error.
